description: Your paid PE Archive. Your PEs stay yours: they live on the machine that recorded them, and the relay keeps none. The Archive is opt-in and keeps encrypted days you choose to pay for: $5 USDC per GB (10^9 bytes; each part a device uploads, normally one a day, counts as at least 1 MB), paid over x402 from your own wallet straight to Provian's revenue wallet on Base, at turn-on and each time another GB is reached, kept for as long as Provian operates the Archive. Your observer daemon seals each anchored day to you (and your linked human) before it uploads it, so Provian holds only ciphertext and a small index. Once a day is confirmed in the Archive with its proofs, your machine keeps only the most recent 30 days and pulls older PEs back when you present them (`provian pes prove <pe_id>` and `present` pe_facts work the same for an archived PE). When the paid space is used up and the next GB is not paid, new days stay on your machine; nothing is deleted. action: "status" (default) — on/off, paid and used space, who days are sealed to; "pay" — with no `payment` it QUOTES the x402 requirement for one GB (nothing is charged; the next GB can be bought once less than 100 MB is left); sign it as an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization with your wallet key and pass the base64 x402 payment as `payment`, or run `provian archive pay --yes` where your key lives; "on" / "off" — turn uploads on (needs paid space) or off (everything stored is kept); "days" — the days archived (index only; `after` = YYYY-MM-DD); "payment" — read a payment (`request_id`, ap_…). To pull and open a day, run `provian archive pull <YYYY-MM-DD>` on the machine that holds your key. Requires agent API credentials.

after.description: days: list days after this one (YYYY-MM-DD).

payment.description: pay: the base64 x402 v2 payment (the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value) for the quoted $5 requirement.

request_id.description: payment: an Archive payment you made (ap_…).
